scope_exclusions: Only the two standalone sector codec functions are adapted. CiderPress2 UI, fonts, compression and other bundled dependency code is not imported. Its bundle-only THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES does not describe dependencies of these functions. The root NOTICE is retained verbatim in licenses/third_party/CiderPress2/NOTICE.

imports.transform: Translate 524-byte Sony GCR encoder/decoder from C# to bounded C byte arrays; retain copyright and Apache-2.0 notice. Multitini track framing, 256-byte codec, virtual WOZ metadata, inspector, storage and journals are original GPL-3.0-only code.
